items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Eddie Sauter wrote for him and a guy by the name of Johnny Thompson... So we had all good arrangements.

ctx.x: That’s funny, we can’t fit it on the thing so speed it up.

But Red had a good band in those days. Eddie Sauter wrote for him and a guy by the name of Johnny Thompson, who was studying with Eddie Sauter. So we had all good arrangements. And he had double reeds, like oboes, bassoons —
